body.name: population cumulant-flag class
body.construction:
Let \(\Theta_{\mathrm{pop}}\) be the class of parameters
\[
 \theta=(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,
          \{\epsilon_{u,e},\epsilon_{t,e}\}_{e\in\mathcal E},
          \epsilon_y)
\]
for which \(U_e=\epsilon_{u,e}\),
\(T_e=\alpha U_e+\epsilon_{t,e}\), and
\(Y_e=\beta T_e+\gamma U_e+\epsilon_y\) for every
\(e\in\mathcal E\), and which satisfy every member property listed below.
